# Ko-fi triggers

![Adding a trigger: on the Actions page, click + Trigger and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-trigger-picker.png)

## Commission

Runs when someone pays for a Ko-fi commission (a custom piece of work). It is also added to the commission list. Needs your Ko-fi webhook set up.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum amount** | The smallest amount that runs this. Example: 5 ignores anything under 5. Leave 0 to run for any amount. Amounts are not converted between currencies. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | The biggest amount that runs this. Leave 0 for no upper limit. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currencies** | Only run for these currencies. Type the short codes with commas, like "USD, EUR". Leave empty for every currency. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Supporter's choice** | Supporters can tick "make this private" on Ko-fi. "Public only" runs just for public supports, "Private only" just for private ones, "Any" for both. Private ones arrive as "Anonymous" with no message unless you turn on showing them on the Webhooks page. Options: Any, Public only, Private only. Starts as: `Any`. |
| **Skip late deliveries** | Tick to not run for payments that arrive late, because your own relay kept them while Cuebot was closed. They still count in the feed, totals and the Ko-fi goal, so you are not flooded with old thank-yous. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who supported you. "Anonymous" when they gave no name or marked the support private (unless you turned on showing private supporters) |
| `%amount%` | The amount as a number, like 5 or 12.5 |
| `%currency%` | The currency code, like USD |
| `%formattedAmount%` | The amount written nicely, like "$5.00" |
| `%message%` | Their message. Empty when the support is private (unless you turned on showing private supporters) |
| `%isPublic%` | False when the supporter marked the support private. Keep their name off stream then |
| `%privateName%` | Only for private supports: the supporter's real Ko-fi name. For your own records only, never show it on stream |
| `%privateMessage%` | Only for private supports: their real message. For your own records only |
| `%from%` | The supporter's Ko-fi name as sent (empty for a hidden private support) |
| `%url%` | A web link to the Ko-fi page of this support |
| `%messageId%` | Ko-fi's id for this delivery (the same when Ko-fi re-sends it) |
| `%transactionId%` | Ko-fi's transaction id |
| `%timestamp%` | When Ko-fi says the payment happened |
| `%kofiType%` | Ko-fi's own name for the type: Donation, Subscription, Commission or Shop Order |
| `%isSubscriptionPayment%` | True for a membership payment |
| `%isReplay%` | True when the payment reached Cuebot late, because your own relay kept it while Cuebot was closed |
| `%delaySeconds%` | How many seconds after the relay got it the payment reached Cuebot |
| `%discordUserId%` | The supporter's Discord user id, when they linked Discord on Ko-fi. Put it in a Discord step's Member box to DM them |
| `%discordUsername%` | The supporter's Discord name, when they linked Discord |
| `%discordMention%` | Mentions them in a Discord channel message (<@id>), when they linked Discord |
| `%kofiGoalCurrent%` | The Ko-fi goal's progress after this payment (see the Webhooks page) |
| `%kofiGoalTarget%` | The Ko-fi goal's target (0 when there is no goal) |
| `%kofiGoalPercent%` | The Ko-fi goal's progress in whole percent |
| `%kofiGoalTitle%` | The Ko-fi goal's title |
| `%kofiGoalCurrency%` | The currency the Ko-fi goal counts (empty = every currency) |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |
| `%commissionsOpen%` | How many commissions are open now, this one included |

<small>Type id: `kofi.commission`</small>

## Goal Reached

Runs once when the Ko-fi goal Cuebot keeps reaches its target. Set the goal on the Webhooks page. It can run again after a reset or a higher target.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who made the payment that reached it (empty when you added to the goal by hand) |
| `%kofiGoalTitle%` | The goal's title |
| `%kofiGoalCurrent%` | The progress now |
| `%kofiGoalTarget%` | The target |
| `%kofiGoalPercent%` | The progress in whole percent |
| `%kofiGoalCurrency%` | The currency the goal counts |
| `%service%` | Ko-fi |
| `%isTest%` | Always false (test events never count) |

<small>Type id: `kofi.goalReached`</small>

## Membership Lapsed

Runs once when a Ko-fi member has not paid for longer than the days set on the Webhooks page (35 by default). Ko-fi never says when a membership ends, so this is an estimate: a late payment simply starts the count again.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Tier name** | Only run for these membership levels, like "Gold" or "Gold, Silver". Capitals and spaces do not matter. Leave empty for any level. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The member's name ("Anonymous" for a private supporter) |
| `%tier%` | Their membership level |
| `%amount%` | What they paid last time |
| `%currency%` | The currency code |
| `%lastPayment%` | When they last paid |
| `%daysSincePayment%` | Days since that payment |
| `%payments%` | How many payments Cuebot saw from them |
| `%privateName%` | Only for a private supporter: their real Ko-fi name, for your own records |
| `%discordUserId%` | Their Discord user id, when linked |
| `%discordUsername%` | Their Discord name, when linked |
| `%isEstimate%` | Always true: Ko-fi never says when a membership ends |
| `%service%` | Ko-fi |
| `%isTest%` | Always false |

<small>Type id: `kofi.membershipLapsed`</small>

## Shop Order

| --- | --- |
| **Minimum amount** | The smallest amount that runs this. Example: 5 ignores anything under 5. Leave 0 to run for any amount. Amounts are not converted between currencies. Starts as: `0`. |
